description: This file contains unit tests for pairing file helper functions such as path resolution, pending request pruning, and request reconciliation, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: resolvePairingPaths
methods.description: Resolves the directory and JSON file paths for pairing files given a base directory and subdirectory.

methods.name: pruneExpiredPending
methods.description: Removes pending requests from the list that are older than a specified TTL.

methods.name: reconcilePendingPairingRequests
methods.description: Synchronizes pending pairing requests based on incoming requests, allowing for refresh, merge, and persistence.

ctags.name: existing
ctags.pattern: /^    const existing = { requestId: "req-1", deviceId: "device-1", ts: 1, version: 1 };$/
